items.title: In war, anything can happen; in investing, only management matters. 6 stocks from different sectors with upside potential of up to 27%
items.description: Net margin is a useful metric. It tells you how much profit remains after costs, interest, and tax are deducted from revenue. But it does not tell you whether the sector is structurally tough. It does not tell you whether management has pricing discipline. It does not tell you whether the company has survived a crisis that killed competitors. It does not tell you whether the business can reinvest. It does not tell you whether low margin is a weakness or simply the price of operating in a hard but defensible industry. It does not necessarily tell you whether the stock is worth picking up in the market.

items.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide D-Street action on Monday
items.description: Indian equities saw a broad-based selloff on Friday, led by IT stocks, dragging benchmarks sharply lower. Nifty fell 1.14% and Sensex dropped 1.29%, while India VIX rose 6%. items.title: 14 penny stocks surge up to 125% in a month; 2 turn multibaggers. Did you own any?
items.description: In the past 1-month, 14 penny stocks have delivered impressive gains ranging from 40% to 125%, including two multibaggers. These outperformers were identified using specific filters: market capitalisation below Rs 1,000 crore, share price under Rs 20, and a minimum trading volume of 5 lakh shares. This approach helped spotlight low-priced, actively traded micro-cap stocks exhibiting strong upward momentum.Penny stocks continue to attract interest due to their low price points and high return potential. However, they carry substantial risk, marked by low liquidity, sharp volatility, and limited transparency. For investors, success in this segment requires more than luck—it demands discipline, thorough research, and strong risk management. (Data Source: ACE Equity)

items.title: In a volatile market, odds do favour contrarians, but only if they have an edge: 4 stocks from different sectors with dividend yield of up to 5.8%
items.description: When a fundamentally strong business is available at 4% dividend yield, the probability that you will have both dividend and the capital gains, rather than just one or the other, is materially higher than what the market is currently pricing. You are not betting on a recovery that might not come. You are betting on a recovery that, given the quality of the business and the management’s track record, has the probability skewed in your favour. In a market oscillating violently, where growth is scarce and volatility is high, that probability edge is worth looking at.

items.title: Warren Buffett once treated Bill Gates at McDonald's using coupons: How frugal is his lifestyle
items.description: Warren Buffett’s famously frugal lifestyle is reflected in everything from using McDonald’s coupons to letting market conditions decide his daily breakfast spend. The Berkshire Hathaway chief’s simple habits—from modest living to disciplined spending—underscore his belief that wealth doesn’t equate to luxury, but to long-term value and contentment.
